feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: White supremacist convicted of plotting to firebomb migrant hotel
articles.summary: A 24-year-old white supremacist has been convicted of plotting to firebomb a migrant hotel and kill as many occupants as possible.

articles.title: Two dead after microlight glider crashes
articles.summary: The bodies of two men have been recovered after a microlight glider crashed into a Scottish loch.

articles.title: 'Danny Tommo' jailed for slashing migrant dinghy
articles.summary: Anti-migrant activist Danny Tommo has been sentenced to 15 months in prison after using a knife to slash a boat in the English Channel.

articles.title: Poundland chief shares pain with staff amid last-ditch rescue talks
articles.summary: Poundland's boss has told thousands of employees at the discount chain of his "hurt" at the parlous position in which it finds itself, days before it faces collapsing into administration.

articles.title: British Gas owner Centrica cuts hundreds of jobs in Business unit
articles.summary: The FTSE 100 energy company Centrica is cutting hundreds of jobs as part of a cost-saving drive.

articles.title: Train attack knifeman was 'in clutches of acute psychotic episode', court told
articles.summary: A knifeman who stabbed 10 people on a London-bound train was "in the clutches of an acute psychotic episode", a jury has been told.

articles.title: Calls for consent law change after Joanne Young rape case
articles.summary: Calls for a change to the law on consent have grown in the wake of the Joanne Young rape case.

articles.title: Man accused of killing British woman sent knife with her blood on to friend
articles.summary: A man accused of murdering a British woman he met on a fetish website sent a knife with her blood on it to a friend, a US court has heard.

articles.title: Anti-monarchy group hands over 'evidence' on Andrew as it calls for investigation
articles.summary: An anti-monarchy campaign group says it has given police and the Crown Prosecution Service "evidence" on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

articles.title: UK conducting offensive cyber ops against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, says top commander
articles.summary: The UK is conducting offensive cyber operations against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, a top military commander has for the first time revealed.
